# Orderflow Society

> Futures orderflow trading mentorship and free community run by Amrit (@amrittrades), an ES and NQ futures trader who trades with orderflow on ATAS.

## 1-on-1 Orderflow Mentorship
- 10 private 1-on-1 sessions with Amrit, 60 to 90 minutes each, over Discord or Zoom
- Trade reviews, direct private chat for feedback, ATAS and TradingView templates
- Price: $999 for all 10 sessions, or 2 x $500 (the second payment after session 4). A single session costs $150.
- Scheduling: no fixed schedule. The student picks when, then the session is booked, in any time zone. Students start on the New York session, then move to London or Asia if needed.
- Topics: footprint charts, delta, absorption, DOM, heatmap, volume profile, VWAP, auction market theory, ATAS setup
- No profit guarantees. Trading futures involves substantial risk of loss.
- Refunds: payments are refundable within 24 hours of purchase only.
- Apply: https://www.orderflowsociety.com/#mentorship or DM @amrittrades on Instagram
